name: Weaver
description: The cave's middle body, and the one that changes the ground. Three spinnerets stand off the back of a tilted abdomen with a thread still on them, and that is the read: it is not coming for you so much as laying floor as it goes. Dusky violet where the chaff is cream, so the body the elite marking lands on mid-run is the one already telling itself apart. Gameplay radius 10.

elite.description: Marked: bleached carapace, a brighter chevron, and silk standing out white on the spinnerets.

spin.description: a walking gait with the abdomen doing a second thing: the spinnerets work against the sway and the thread behind them lags a beat, so the body reads as paying out line while it travels rather than as walking with something stuck to it
